strings.0.5 = riflesso fisico derivato dall'IOR: 0.5 = physical reflection derived from the IOR
strings.Colore della luce dopo «Profondità color: Color of the light after travelling «Color depth» inside the object. For liquids use this and leave the base color white: darker where it is deep, lighter at the edges, as in reality.

strings.Scurisce le cavità. Il path tracer calco: Darkens the cavities. The path tracer already computes real occlusion: low values are more faithful.
strings.Proiezione cubica sfumata: non richiede: Blended cubic projection: needs no UVs, the scale is in real meters
strings.La texture segue il singolo pezzo quando: The texture follows the single part when you move or rotate it
strings.Una sola proiezione per tutto l'assieme:: One projection for the whole assembly: continuous grain across parts, follows the assembly
strings.Texture ferma nella scena: l'oggetto ci: Texture fixed in the scene: the object slides over it when you move it (as up to 0.14)
strings.Usa le coordinate UV del modello (glTF/O: Use the model's UV coordinates (glTF/OBJ exported with UVs)
strings.Lato reale di una piastrella della textu: Real side of one texture tile: smaller = more repeats (e.g. smaller bricks)
strings.Quante volte la texture si ripete sul la: How many times the texture repeats along the longest side of the selected object ({})
strings.Quante volte la texture si ripete sull'i: How many times the texture repeats over the model's 0–1 UV range
strings.{}: valori scritti dalla fonte (non coll: {}: values written by the source (not linked to maps).
No numeric values in the file.
strings.Usa la scala del displacement del file (: Use the displacement scale from the file ({mm:.1} mm)
strings.MaterialX esprime la scala in unità dell: MaterialX expresses the scale in scene units (meters): value × 1000 = mm. Check the result: apply it and look at the render.
strings.Dettaglio fine dell'ombreggiatura (non c: Fine shading detail (does not change the silhouette)
strings.Bump mapping dalla height: solo ombreggi: Bump mapping from the height: shading only. 0 = off (usually not needed with a normal map)
strings.Displacement vero: la superficie viene s: Real displacement: the surface is subdivided and moved according to the height map, so the silhouette and shadows change too. 0 = off. Heavier to prepare.
strings.Accende il displacement al 3 % del lato: Turns on displacement at 3 % of the texture side: for materials with real relief (stones, bricks, bark). For metals, paints and plastics leave it at 0.
strings.Grigio che lascia la superficie dov'è: 0: Gray that leaves the surface where it is: 0.5 = half outwards and half inwards, 0 = outwards only
strings.Il displacement si vede nel render (non: Displacement is visible in the render (not in the modelling viewport).
strings.Sostituisce tutte le luci, adattandole a: Replaces all the lights, fitting them to the size of the scene
strings.Per gli interni illuminati dall'HDRI: il: For interiors lit by the HDRI: the renderer looks for sky light through this rectangle instead of at random, with much less grain. Selecting the window glass or opening first puts it in the right place.
strings.Seleziona una luce nell'elenco a sinistr: Select a light in the list on the left.
strings.Il portale non emette luce: indica da do: The portal emits no light: it marks where the environment light (HDRI) comes in. Put it on the window opening, with the arrow pointing inside and as large as the opening. Remove the window glass or make it invisible, otherwise it blocks the rays.
strings.Angolo pieno del fascio (si regola anche: Full beam angle (also adjusted by dragging the solid handle of the cone in the viewport)
strings.0 % = bordo netto, 100 % = sfuma dal cen: 0 % = sharp edge, 100 % = fades from the center (hollow handle in the viewport)
strings.Spento = luce fisica, arriva ovunque. Ac: Off = physical light, it reaches everywhere. On = the light stops at the edge of the bubble
strings.Fin dove arriva la luce (bolla piena nel: How far the light reaches (solid bubble in the viewport)
strings.0 % = taglio netto al bordo, 100 % = sfu: 0 % = hard cut at the edge, 100 % = fades from the source to the edge (dashed bubble)
strings.Se disattivato lo sfondo è nero, ma l'am: When off the background is black, but the environment still lights the scene and shows in reflections
strings.La HDRI illumina la scena con importance: The HDRI lights the scene with importance sampling (sun and windows sampled directly). Free CC0 maps: polyhaven.com (also from the «Download HDRI…» button).
strings.Nebbia pesante da un emettitore (sopra l: Heavy fog from an emitter (above the selected object or at the scene center): it falls, fills containers, overflows and spreads on the ground
strings.Aria velata e raggi di luce visibili (in: Hazy air and visible light rays (on the roadmap)
strings.Immagine applicata su una superficie (in: Image applied to a surface (on the roadmap)
strings.Nessun effetto: aggiungine uno dai pulsa: No effects: add one with the buttons above.
strings.Attivo nel render (togliendo la spunta r: Active in the render (unchecked it stays in the scene, switched off)
strings.Seleziona: il gizmo sposta l'emettitore: Select: the gizmo moves the emitter
strings.Sposta il punto da cui esce la nebbia (l: Moves the point the fog comes out of (the zone follows it)
strings.Sposta il riquadro simulato lasciando l': Moves the simulated box leaving the emitter where it is (e.g. higher for puffs)
strings.Metti sopra la selezione: Put on top of the selection
strings.Sposta l'emettitore sul lato superiore d: Moves the emitter onto the top side of the selected components
strings.L'emettitore è fuori dalla zona: non usc: The emitter is outside the zone: no fog will come out.
strings.Preset (passa sopra per vedere dove mett: Presets (hover to see where to put the emitter):
strings.Un'altra forma con gli stessi parametri: Another shape with the same parameters
strings.Secondi di emissione: la nebbia è calcol: Seconds of emission: the fog is computed at that instant (more time = bigger pool)
strings.Coefficiente di estinzione della nebbia: Extinction coefficient of the full fog (1/m): higher = more opaque
strings.Dimensione di sbuffi, filamenti e vortic: Size of puffs, wisps and swirls
strings.Quanto la nebbia, scaldandosi, risale a: How much the fog, warming up, rises in puffs before vanishing (0 = stays on the ground like a liquid; high = puffs above the source)
strings.Velocità con cui la nebbia si dissolve n: How fast the fog dissolves into the air (0 = never)
strings.Quanta luce la nebbia diffonde invece di: How much light the fog scatters instead of absorbing (1 = white, 0 = black smoke)
strings.0 = diffusione uniforme; positiva = più: 0 = uniform scattering; positive = brighter against the light
strings.La nebbia si appoggia sugli oggetti e ci: The fog rests on objects and flows around them
strings.Simulazione fino a {cells} celle, dettag: Simulation up to {cells} cells, detail {res} cells along the longest side of the zone. Each level up makes the motion finer but the computation 3–5 times slower (Ultra: minutes and a few hundred MB of memory).
strings.Celle della griglia del dettaglio (sbuff: Cells of the detail grid (puffs, edges) along the longest side. The motion is set by the grid quality; a smaller zone gives finer cells.
strings.Nessuna HDRI: copia i file .hdr/.exr nel: No HDRI: copy .hdr/.exr files into the library HDRI folder, or download one.
strings.Poi clicca un oggetto nella viewport: la: Then click an object in the viewport: the camera frames it, focuses on it and orbits around it while staying locked
strings.Viewport: trascina = orbita · Shift/dest: Viewport: drag = orbit · Shift/right/middle = pan · wheel = zoom · double click = frame
strings.0 = automatico (thread logici − 1, per l: 0 = automatic (logical threads − 1, to keep the interface responsive)
strings.Il rendering continua finché non lo ferm: Rendering continues until you stop it
strings.Si può cambiare durante il rendering: l': Can be changed while rendering: accumulation continues without restarting.
strings.Campionamento adattivo: ogni zona dell'i: Adaptive sampling: each area of the image stops when the estimated noise drops below the threshold; the time goes to the hard areas (glass, shadows, fog). The number of samples above stays the maximum.
strings.Più bassa = più pulita e più lenta. Sull: Lower = cleaner and slower. On the test scene: 0.08 ≈ quality of 64 samples, 0.04 ≈ 256, 0.02 ≈ 1000. Worth it with backgrounds and easy areas; in dark scenes with fog and sparkles it can cost more than uniform rendering (in development).
strings.Campioni per pixel prima di valutare il: Samples per pixel before evaluating the noise (avoids stopping too early in areas with rare light)
0 = off (physically correct). Values > 0 reduce fireflies by introducing bias.
strings.Le impostazioni sono cambiate: premi Ria: The settings have changed: press Restart to apply them.
strings.Open Image Denoise non trovato: il rende: Open Image Denoise not found: the render stays without noise reduction.
strings.Solo immagine finale: ripulisce a fine r:
Final image only: cleans at the end of the render, when paused or when you stop it.
Fast preview: also cleans during the render at 8, 16, 32… samples, so you see the result right away.
strings.Esegue il denoiser sulla GPU NVIDIA con:
Runs the denoiser on the NVIDIA GPU with the tensor cores: much faster, ideal for the preview.
Requires a Volta or newer GPU (RTX 20/30/40/50, Quadro RTX) and the NVIDIA driver; no CUDA Toolkit to install.
If it is not available the CPU is used automatically.
strings.CUDA non disponibile su questa GPU: il d: CUDA not available on this GPU: the denoiser uses the CPU.
strings.Poi a ogni raddoppio dei campioni (es. 8: Then at every doubling of the samples (e.g. 8, 16, 32, 64…)
strings.Miscela tra l'immagine grezza (0 %) e qu: Blend between the raw image (0 %) and the cleaned one (100 %): useful if the filter flattens fine details
strings.Guida il filtro con colore e orientament: Guides the filter with the color and orientation of the surfaces: edges, text and textures stay sharp
strings.Il render usa la camera attiva: nella vi: The render uses the active camera: in the viewport you move freely without losing the framing.
strings.Nessuna: il render usa la vista della vi: None: the render uses the viewport view
strings.Usa questa camera per il render: Use this camera for the render
strings.Guarda attraverso: porta la vista su que: Look through: moves the view to this framing
strings.Imposta dalla vista: questa camera prend: Set from view: this camera takes the current viewport framing
strings.Crea una camera di rendering con l'inqua: Create a render camera with the current framing
strings.La camera attiva segue i movimenti della: The active camera follows the viewport movements (to adjust the framing by moving through the scene)
strings.Vista libera: il render resta sull'inqua: Free view: the render stays on the active camera framing («Look» to go back to it).
strings.Camera usata dal render (le camere si cr: Camera used by the render (cameras are created in the Camera tab)
strings.Come una fotocamera: gli oggetti lontani: Like a camera: far objects are smaller
strings.Raggi paralleli: misure costanti con la: Parallel rays: sizes stay constant with distance (technical, isometric view). No depth of field
strings.Quella che la prospettiva avrebbe alla d: The one the perspective would have at the target distance (follows the zoom)
strings.Focale equivalente full frame (sensore 3: Full-frame equivalent focal length (36×24 mm sensor)
strings.Sfocato ottico reale (lente sottile): ni: Real optical blur (thin lens): sharp on the focus plane, blurred in front and behind
strings.Numero f: più basso = più sfocato (zona: f-number: lower = more blur (narrow sharp zone), higher = sharper
strings.Clicca nella viewport il punto da metter: Click the point to focus on in the viewport
strings.Mette a fuoco il centro dei componenti s: Focuses on the center of the selected components
strings.Calcolata come su una fotocamera full fr: Computed as on a full-frame camera (circle of confusion 0.03 mm)
strings.Forma del bokeh: le luci sfocate diventa: Bokeh shape: blurred lights become polygons as in real lenses
strings.Shift (come un obiettivo decentrabile):: Shift (like a shift lens): moves the framing without tilting the camera, so verticals stay straight (tall products, architecture)

strings.Emettitore nel bicchiere poco sotto il b: Emitter in the glass just below the rim: a little fog that spills over the edge, runs down the stem and curls.
strings.Emettitore nel calderone o in una ciotol: Emitter in the cauldron or a large bowl: dense fog that bubbles over the rim and slides to the ground.
strings.Emettitore a 20–40 cm da terra (la bocca: Emitter 20–40 cm above the ground (the machine nozzle): low, compact carpet covering the floor.
strings.Acceso: Claude può comandare questa fine: On: Claude can control this window (through forgerender-mcp). Click to turn off.
strings.Spento: nessun assistente può comandare: Off: no assistant can control ForgeRender. Click to let Claude connect.
strings.Usa tutti i core del processore: funzion: Uses all processor cores: works on every PC
strings.Utilizzo GPU e VRAM si leggono con il dr: GPU usage and VRAM are read through the NVIDIA driver (NVML): with AMD or Intel cards, or without the NVIDIA driver, they are not available
strings.La scheda che fa il render non è NVIDIA:: The card doing the render is not NVIDIA: NVML reads NVIDIA cards only
strings.{}: VRAM usata da tutti i programmi, let: {}: VRAM used by all programs, read from the NVIDIA driver every second
strings.ForgeRender usa componenti open source:: ForgeRender uses open source components: Intel Open Image Denoise (Apache 2.0 license, with oneTBB and oneDNN); egui, wgpu and other Rust libraries (MIT / Apache 2.0); Open CASCADE (LGPL 2.1, STEP converter only). Full texts in the program's licenze folder.
strings.Annulla l'ultima modifica di posizione,: Undoes the last change of position, rotation, scale or deletion
strings.Appoggia il prodotto sul pavimento o sul: Rests the product on the floor or backdrop
strings.Appoggia il prodotto, aggiunge il fondal: Rests the product, adds the backdrop if missing, applies look and quality and frames the shot
strings.Avvia, mette in pausa o riprende il path: Starts, pauses or resumes path tracing
strings.Cerca e scarica materiali e HDRI gratuit: Search and download free materials and HDRIs
strings.Chiude ForgeRender (chiede prima di perd: Closes ForgeRender (asks before losing unsaved changes)
strings.Dove sono salvati materiali, HDRI e text: Where materials, HDRIs and textures are stored
strings.Il progetto ha modifiche non salvate. Sa: The project has unsaved changes. Save them before continuing?
strings.Il progetto non esiste più: {}\nTolto da:
The project no longer exists: {}
Removed from the recent list.
strings.Impostazioni riportate ai valori inizial: Settings reset to their initial values.
strings.Inquadra il prodotto senza pavimento e f: Frames the product without floor and backdrop
strings.JPG (leggero, per web e social): JPG (small, for web and social media)
strings.Lingua, libreria e import, percorsi, val: Language, library and import, paths, new project values
strings.Materiali con texture e HDRI salvati sul: Textured materials and HDRIs stored on this computer
strings.Ortografica: misure senza prospettiva, c: Orthographic: measurements without perspective, like a technical drawing
strings.Passato alla modalità Avanzata (si torna: Switched to Advanced mode (switch back to Simple at the top left).
strings.Permette a Claude di comandare questa fi: Lets Claude control this window (through forgerender-mcp)
strings.Rifà fondale e luci sulle misure attuali: Rebuilds backdrop and lights for the product's current size
strings.Salva il progetto (la prima volta chiede: Saves the project (asks where the first time)
strings.Salva il render: PNG, JPG, TIFF 16 bit o: Saves the render: PNG, JPG, 16-bit TIFF or EXR (chosen in the dialog)
strings.Salva una copia del progetto con un altr: Saves a copy of the project under another name
strings.Sfere, cubo e toro su fondale, con luci: Spheres, cube and torus on a backdrop with studio lights: for trying materials and settings
strings.Sposta la camera di lato (anche tasto de: Pans the camera (also right or middle button)
strings.Sposta la selezione invece della camera: Moves the selection instead of the camera
strings.Toglie dal progetto gli oggetti selezion: Removes the selected objects from the project (the imported file is not touched; Ctrl+Z brings them back)
strings.Cartella \"manuale\" non trovata accanto: "manuale" folder not found next to the program.
strings.Il manuale di ForgeRender. F1 sopra un c: The ForgeRender manual. F1 over a control opens its page
strings.Lingua del manuale (di solito segue quel: Manual language (usually follows the interface language)
strings.Liquido in un bicchiere: modella il liqu: Liquid in a glass: model the liquid slightly larger than the cavity (so it enters the glass thickness) and give it a higher priority than the glass. The engine then uses the correct glass-liquid interface (IOR 1.5 - 1.33).
